note: For fixed k>=0, count length-(2k+1) words over {H,T} having at least k+1 H's. Letter complementation pairs this class with the class having at least k+1 T's, so its size is half of 2^(2k+1), namely 4^k. If the (k+1)-st H occurs at position k+j+1, then 0<=j<=k; the prefix has k H's and j T's in binom(k+j,j) orders and the remaining k-j positions are arbitrary, giving 2^(k-j)binom(k+j,j). This partitions the counted class and proves the target exactly.
